mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ORDER_INFO (CLI_CODE, ORDER_ID, STATUS, ORDER_DATE) VALUES (#{cliCode}, #{orderId}, #{status}, #{orderDate})
mapper.select: SELECT oi.ORDER_NUM, it.ITEM_NUM, oi.ORDER_ID, oi.ORDER_DATE, oi.STATUS, oi.CLI_CODE, ci.CLI_COMP_NAME, it.PRODUCT, it.PRODUCT_LABEL, it.WIDTH, it.LENGTH, it.ROLLS, it.DESTINATION, it.NOTE, it.DELIVERY_DATE, it.UNIT_PRICE, it.ALIAS_NAME, it.CUT_DONE, (SELECT a.ACTOR FROM ORDER_AUDIT a WHERE a.ORDER_NUM = oi.ORDER_NUM AND a.ACTION = 'CREATE' ORDER BY a.AUDIT_NUM LIMIT 1) AS CREATED_BY FROM ORDER_INFO oi LEFT JOIN ORDER_ITEM it ON it.ORDER_NUM = oi.ORDER_NUM LEFT JOIN CLIENT_INFO ci ON ci.CLI_CODE = oi.CLI_CODE ORDER BY oi.ORDER_DATE DESC, oi.ORDER_NUM DESC, it.ITEM_NUM ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE ORDER_INFO SET STATUS = #{status} WHERE ORDER_NUM = #{orderNum}
UPDATE ORDER_INFO SET ORDER_DATE = #{orderDate} WHERE ORDER_NUM = #{orderNum}
mapper.select: SELECT oi.ORDER_NUM, it.ITEM_NUM, oi.ORDER_ID, oi.ORDER_DATE, oi.STATUS, oi.CLI_CODE, ci.CLI_COMP_NAME, it.PRODUCT, it.PRODUCT_LABEL, it.WIDTH, it.LENGTH, it.ROLLS, it.DESTINATION, it.NOTE, it.DELIVERY_DATE, it.UNIT_PRICE, it.ALIAS_NAME, it.CUT_DONE FROM ORDER_ITEM it JOIN ORDER_INFO oi ON oi.ORDER_NUM = it.ORDER_NUM LEFT JOIN CLIENT_INFO ci ON ci.CLI_CODE = oi.CLI_CODE WHERE it.ITEM_NUM = #{itemNum}
mapper.update: UPDATE ORDER_ITEM SET CUT_DONE = #{cutDone} WHERE ITEM_NUM = #{itemNum}

UPDATE ORDER_ITEM SET PRODUCT = #{product}, PRODUCT_LABEL = #{productLabel}, WIDTH = #{width}, LENGTH = #{length}, ROLLS = #{rolls}, DESTINATION = #{destination}, NOTE = #{note}, DELIVERY_DATE = #{deliveryDate}, UNIT_PRICE = #{unitPrice}, ALIAS_NAME = #{aliasName} WHERE ITEM_NUM = #{itemNum}
mapper.select: SELECT oi.ORDER_NUM, it.ITEM_NUM, oi.ORDER_ID, oi.ORDER_DATE, oi.STATUS, oi.CLI_CODE, ci.CLI_COMP_NAME, it.PRODUCT, it.PRODUCT_LABEL, it.WIDTH, it.LENGTH, it.ROLLS, it.DESTINATION, it.NOTE, it.DELIVERY_DATE, it.UNIT_PRICE, it.ALIAS_NAME FROM ORDER_INFO oi LEFT JOIN ORDER_ITEM it ON it.ORDER_NUM = oi.ORDER_NUM LEFT JOIN CLIENT_INFO ci ON ci.CLI_CODE = oi.CLI_CODE WHERE oi.STATUS IN ('PENDING','FAILED') AND oi.ORDER_DATE > (NOW() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR) ORDER BY oi.ORDER_NUM, it.ITEM_NUM

SELECT oi.ORDER_NUM, it.ITEM_NUM, oi.ORDER_ID, oi.ORDER_DATE, oi.STATUS, oi.CLI_CODE, ci.CLI_COMP_NAME, it.PRODUCT, it.PRODUCT_LABEL, it.WIDTH, it.LENGTH, it.ROLLS, it.DESTINATION, it.NOTE, it.DELIVERY_DATE, it.UNIT_PRICE, it.ALIAS_NAME FROM ORDER_INFO oi LEFT JOIN ORDER_ITEM it ON it.ORDER_NUM = oi.ORDER_NUM LEFT JOIN CLIENT_INFO ci ON ci.CLI_CODE = oi.CLI_CODE WHERE oi.STATUS = 'DEFERRED' ORDER BY oi.ORDER_NUM, it.ITEM_NUM
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ORDER_ITEM WHERE ORDER_NUM = #{orderNum}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ORDER_ITEM (ORDER_NUM, PRODUCT, PRODUCT_LABEL, WIDTH, LENGTH, ROLLS, DESTINATION, NOTE, UNIT_PRICE, ALIAS_NAME) VALUES (#{orderNum}, #{product}, #{productLabel}, #{width}, #{length}, #{rolls}, #{destination}, #{note}, #{unitPrice}, #{aliasName})
mapper.select: SELECT MAX(ORDER_ID) FROM ORDER_INFO WHERE ORDER_ID LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix}, '%')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ORDER_INFO WHERE ORDER_NUM > COALESCE(#{lastSeen}, 0)

SELECT oi.ORDER_NUM, oi.ORDER_ID, ci.CLI_COMP_NAME, oi.ORDER_DATE, oi.STATUS, (SELECT it.PRODUCT_LABEL FROM ORDER_ITEM it WHERE it.ORDER_NUM = oi.ORDER_NUM ORDER BY it.ITEM_NUM LIMIT 1) AS FIRST_PRODUCT_LABEL, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ORDER_ITEM it WHERE it.ORDER_NUM = oi.ORDER_NUM) AS ITEM_COUNT, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(it.ROLLS), 0) FROM ORDER_ITEM it WHERE it.ORDER_NUM = oi.ORDER_NUM) AS TOTAL_ROLLS FROM ORDER_INFO oi LEFT JOIN CLIENT_INFO ci ON ci.CLI_CODE = oi.CLI_CODE WHERE oi.ORDER_NUM > COALESCE(#{lastSeen}, 0) ORDER BY oi.ORDER_NUM DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT oi.ORDER_NUM, oi.ORDER_ID, ci.CLI_COMP_NAME, oi.ORDER_DATE, oi.STATUS, (SELECT it.PRODUCT_LABEL FROM ORDER_ITEM it WHERE it.ORDER_NUM = oi.ORDER_NUM ORDER BY it.ITEM_NUM LIMIT 1) AS FIRST_PRODUCT_LABEL, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ORDER_ITEM it WHERE it.ORDER_NUM = oi.ORDER_NUM) AS ITEM_COUNT, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(it.ROLLS), 0) FROM ORDER_ITEM it WHERE it.ORDER_NUM = oi.ORDER_NUM) AS TOTAL_ROLLS FROM ORDER_INFO oi LEFT JOIN CLIENT_INFO ci ON ci.CLI_CODE = oi.CLI_CODE WHERE oi.ORDER_ID = #{orderId}

SELECT it.DESTINATION FROM ORDER_ITEM it JOIN ORDER_INFO oi ON oi.ORDER_NUM = it.ORDER_NUM WHERE oi.CLI_CODE = #{cliCode} AND it.DESTINATION IS NOT NULL AND it.DESTINATION <> '' GROUP BY it.DESTINATION ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, it.DESTINATION LIMIT 100
